entities.name: Koca Musa Paşa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Koca Musa Pasha was an Ottoman statesman. He served most prominently as Kapudan Pasha (1645–1647), Ottoman governor of Egypt (1630–1631), Ottoman governor of Budin Eyalet, and Ottoman governor of Silistra Eyalet (1644–1645). He was also a vizier.

entities.summary: Koca Musa Pasha was an Ottoman statesman. He served most prominently as Kapudan Pasha (1645–1647), Ottoman governor of Egypt (1630–1631), Ottoman governor of Budin Eyalet, and Ottoman governor of Silistra Eyalet (1644–1645). He was also a vizier.
